description: Detailed breakdown of French notary fees by component (taxes, emoluments, debours). Use for property buyers in France. Inputs: property price, type (new/old). DMTO on old property = 6.32% (departmental 5.00% + communal 1.20% + 2.37% fee on the departmental part; 5.81% for first-time buyers of a main residence or departments at 4.50%). Returns total fees and per-component breakdown. See list_bundles for related 'finance-france' calculators.
